---
title: "Chemical question and exercise"
---

## Question

Give the environmental setting and the chemical prediction to make.

## Inputs and assumptions

Supply concentrations, units, constants, temperature, and the model conditions.
Identify whether the data are measured or simulated.

## Predict and calculate

Ask for a directional prediction, a small hand calculation, and a unit check.
Use R only when a table, repeated calculation, or plot helps answer the question.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Hint"}
Point to the relevant reaction or balance and link any required function help.
:::

## Explain the result

Request a chemical explanation and a statement of the model's limitations.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Worked solution"}
Provide the calculation, checks, and interpretation when the exercise is written.
:::
